generic_rules: Never send ground_truth/ to the model.
Inputs are CC0 / public domain only; every file has a row in data/SOURCES.csv.
Round 1 uses prompt_template unchanged for every case; prompt fixes go in round 2 and are logged as such.
Generate 3 samples per case x model x variant. The API has no seed, so samples are independent draws.
Round 2 changes only the fields named in a case's "round2" block; the template and every other input stay as in round 1.

prompt_template.T1: Image 1 is a flat line drawing of a {item}. Image 2 is a swatch of the fabric. Create a realistic e-commerce product photo of this exact garment made from this exact fabric: keep the silhouette and every construction detail from the drawing, and reproduce the fabric's colours, pattern and texture from the swatch. {scale_note} Show the whole garment front-on, on an invisible mannequin, on a plain light grey background. Do not add trims, prints or details that are not in the drawing.
prompt_template.T2: Image 1 is a photo of a {item}. Image 2 is a swatch of a new fabric. Create the same garment, with the same shape, pose, lighting and construction details, made from the new fabric instead of the original one. {scale_note} Change nothing else.
prompt_template.T3: Image 1 is a flat line drawing of a {item}. Image 2 is a swatch of the fabric for this colourway. Create a realistic e-commerce product photo of this exact garment made from this exact fabric. {scale_note} Show the whole garment front-on, on an invisible mannequin, on a plain light grey background. Do not add trims, prints or details that are not in the drawing.
prompt_template.T4: Image 1 is a photo of a {item}. Recolour the garment: {recolor}. Keep the shape, fabric texture, pattern layout, lighting and background exactly as they are. Change nothing else.
prompt_template.T5: Image 1 is a flat line drawing of a {item}. Image 2 is a swatch of the base fabric. Image 3 is the {motif_name}. Create a realistic e-commerce product photo of this exact garment in this fabric, with the {motif_name} placed {placement}. {scale_note} Show the whole garment front-on, on an invisible mannequin, on a plain light grey background. Do not add details that are not in the drawing.
prompt_template.T6: Image 1 is a flat line drawing of a {item}. Image 2 is a swatch of the fabric. Create a realistic e-commerce product photo of this exact garment made from this exact fabric, reproducing the construction exactly as drawn, especially the {detail}. {scale_note} Show the whole garment front-on, on an invisible mannequin, on a plain light grey background. Do not add details that are not in the drawing.

cases.item: girl's dress with a smocked and pin-tucked yoke, long sleeves with lace cuffs, a draped sash at the hip, petal-cut tiers and lace flounces at the hem, with satin ribbon bows, all in the swatch fabric with cream lace
cases.notes: Plain ivory silk satin; the only flat area is the upper sleeve, so the swatch is small. Construction is heavy (smocking, lace, petal tiers). Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic).

cases.item: woman's two-piece day dress: bodice with a crossover draped front and long sleeves, waistband, draped overskirt and pleated underskirt, all in the swatch fabric, with a small purple silk bow at the neck

scale.basis: stripes counted down the underskirt, the only area where they run straight; measured against the ground truth by autocheck

cases.notes: Stripes run on the bias in the bodice and overskirt and horizontally on the underskirt; the swatch is cut from the underskirt. Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic).

round2.scale_note: The stripes are narrow and must be drawn to scale: about 40 navy stripes fit from collar to hem, each navy stripe about as wide as the cream stripe beside it.
round2.why: Round 1 drew the stripes about twice too wide with no scale note.

cases.item: child's two-piece suit: jacket and pleated skirt in the swatch fabric with black velvet ribbon lattice trims, worn over a white cotton blouse with eyelet lace collar, jabot and cuffs, and white bloomers
cases.source: The Met 159177 (Suit, ca. 1860, wool/cotton/silk, 2009.300.625a-c). The same photo also shows blouse 159178 (28.220), also public domain.
cases.scale_note: The plaid is large: about five vertical repeats from the waistband to the skirt hem.

scale.basis: estimated from the photo: skirt ~1400px tall, vertical repeat ~280px; the Met record has no dimensions

cases.notes: Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic). Swatch crop has one pleat fold down the middle that shifts the pattern; no flat area holds a full repeat. Round 1 item text wrongly says white bloomers; the bloomers in the ground truth are the plaid fabric.

round2.scale_note: The plaid is large and must be drawn to scale: one full repeat is about one seventh of the skirt's width at the hem, so about 7 repeats run across the hem.
round2.why: Round 1 drew the plaid 10-25% too large with a qualitative scale note.

cases.item: short-sleeved knitted jacket with a stand collar, centre-front button closure, ribbed cuffs and hem, and gold patterned bands where drawn, in the swatch's knit
cases.notes: Photographed flat. The swatch is the plain textured knit; the gold bands are described in text and drawn, not given as a swatch. Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic). The traced drawing straightens the real V-shaped front hem and makes the body boxier.

cases.item: man's double-breasted frock coat with notched lapels, a fitted waist seam, a full skirt and covered buttons, in the swatch fabric
cases.source: The Met 84364 (Frock coat, ca. 1840, wool, C.I.38.23.39). Replaces the tweed case: no public-domain tweed garment was found.
cases.notes: Shown on a hanger with the lining visible at the neck. Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic).

cases.material: C05 coat photo + C03 plaid swatch
cases.source: Reuses C05 (Met 84364) as the base photo and C03 (Met 159177) as the swatch; no ground truth exists for a garment re-made in another fabric
checks: silhouette IoU between the base photo and the output (shape must not change)
cases.notes: base_photo.jpg is the C05 garment crop; fabric.jpg is the C03 swatch. No scale note: the plaid's real size is unknown, so pattern scale is not scored.

cases.material: one design in 4 colourways from a museum textile sample book
cases.source: Line drawing reused from C05; swatches cut from one page of a Met textile sample book (229185, 1890s) showing one floral damask in 11 colourways
checks: pairwise silhouette IoU across the 4 colourways (consistency)
ΔE of each output against its own swatch
cases.notes: Scored on consistency across the set, since only one colourway is ever sampled in practice. Colourways: violet on white, grey-blue on white, blue on black, red on black.

cases.material: recolour: navy stripes to burgundy #7A1F2B, cream unchanged
cases.source: Reuses the C02 photo (Met 157306) as the base; no ground truth
cases.recolor: change the navy stripes to burgundy (#7A1F2B) and keep the cream stripes exactly as they are
checks: ΔE of the dark stripes against #7A1F2B
ΔE of the light stripes against the original cream
structure similarity (SSIM) of luminance against the base photo

cases.item: girl's dress with a gathered bodice, ruffled cap sleeves with red trim and a full gathered skirt
cases.material: two prints placed by zone: stripe-and-sprig front panel, red floral side panels and hem border
cases.placement: on the side panels of the skirt and as the wide hem border, with Image 2 on the bodice, sleeves and centre front panel of the skirt
checks: visual: each print in its zone
ΔE of each zone against its swatch
cases.notes: Two swatches: fabric.jpg from the front panel, fabric_b.jpg from a side panel. Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic). The traced drawing shows the hem band but not the seams between the front panel and the side panels, so the side-panel placement rests on the text alone.

cases.item: woman's evening dress with an off-the-shoulder neckline, a deep lace bertha, a pointed fitted bodice and a long gored skirt, in the swatch fabric with cream lace
cases.material: construction: large draped puff sleeves; silk velvet
cases.detail: very large puffed sleeves set at the edge of the shoulders, draped into a deep puff that hangs to the elbow
checks: visual: sleeve volume and taper against the ground truth
cases.notes: Velvet is the second material test after C01 satin: pile and sheen. Line drawing traced by the image model from the ground-truth photo (synthetic).
